method: 4 independent Claude Sonnet 5 passes, one per disjoint 34-item chunk of the 136-item held-out corpus, each given only: the tool's old/new description text, a mechanical newly-added-text hint, and the rubric from build_labels.py's docstring ((a)-(f), applied to newly added text only). None was shown the rule classifier's bucket for that item, the hand labels, holdout-labels-2026-08-22.json, or build_labels.py itself -- this is a blind pass, scored afterward against the committed hand labels by score_model_pass.py.
single_pass_caveat: This is one run, not an ensemble or a repeated-trials average. A second pass would likely relabel some of the borderline calls; treat the numbers as a point estimate, the same caveat this corpus's own hand-labelling carries.
